generator.description: What produced a record: the model, harness, device and run. Self-reported by the device that wrote it. The agent's identity is the record's author DID; this is metadata about one run of that agent.

run.description: Minted when a working session starts; separates one run of the agent from the next.

transcript.description: The transcript segment that produced this record, when the runtime records transcripts.

span.description: A UTF-8 byte range of the record's text, end exclusive.

citation.description: Part of the record's text that rests on another record, with the words in that record it rests on.

via.description: Messages the cited fact was relayed through, nearest first. The target is the original record those messages cited.

basis.description: Part of the record's text that is the author's own, not resting on another record.

textQuote.description: Words that appear in the target's text (W3C Web Annotation quote selector). prefix and suffix pick between repeated occurrences.

byteRange.description: A UTF-8 byte range of the target's content, end exclusive.

jsonPointer.description: A location in the target's structured content (RFC 6901).

source.description: Where an observation's content came from.
